## Notes

> Peta dari membaca kode (2026-10-16, diperiksa ulang 2026-10-19; kode tidak berubah sejak commit b836d02). Perilaku runtime: lihat topics/pillar-1-product.md.

### Arsitektur
- `api/`: Rails 7.0.10 API-only, Ruby 3.3.2, Puma (port 3001), PostgreSQL, Sidekiq 7 + Redis. DB **dipakai bersama `rakamin-api`**: `public.organizations` milik rakamin, tabel app di schema `ai_interview`. JWT HS256 dengan `SECRET_KEY_BASE` yang sama dengan rakamin-api.
- `web/`: React 18 + TS 5.5 (strict) + Vite 6 + Tailwind + Radix (gaya shadcn, `web/src/components/ui/`) + Jotai + axios + react-hook-form/zod. Deploy Vercel (`web/vercel.json`, CSP hardcode host API produksi).
- Real-time: **bukan ActionCable** — Rack middleware faye-websocket + EventMachine (satu thread reactor per worker Puma): `/ws/sessions/:id/audio` (browser ⇄ Gemini Live) dan `/ws/sessions/:id/coverage` (push Redis pub/sub `coverage:<id>` ke assessor).
- AI: Gemini Live (`GEMINI_LIVE_MODEL`) untuk interview suara; Gemini Flash (`GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL`) untuk coverage & narasi fit/gap; Gemini Pro (`GEMINI_PRO_MODEL`) untuk portfolio. Klien di `api/app/clients/gemini/`.
- Ops: `api/Dockerfile` (produksi, jemalloc x86_64), `api/k8s/` (GKE, tanpa secretRef), `api/Procfile`. Tidak ada CI, test, maupun lint di kedua service.

### Data model (`api/db/schema.rb`)
- `users` (global, login hanya role `admin`), `assessments` (tenant, time_limit ∈ 10/30/45/60/90, language en/id, system_prompt) → `assessment_skills` (scope, l1..l5 anchor, expected_level).
- `sessions` (tenant, invite_token hex-64, status pending/active/ended/failed, end_reason manual_candidate/manual_assessor/all_covered/time_ceiling/error, gemini_resumption_token) → `transcript_turns`, `coverage_maps`, `portfolios` (1:1, generation_status) → `portfolio_skills` (ai_level 1..5 NOT NULL, confidence, evidence jsonb[]) → `assessor_overrides`.
- `vacancies` → `vacancy_skills`; `fit_gap_reports` (portfolio×vacancy unik); `skill_taxonomies` (22 skill seed `SK-ENG/SOFT/PM-*`).
- Tenant scope otomatis (`TenantScoped`) hanya di Assessment, Session, Vacancy; model anak harus diakses lewat parent.

### Alur & file kunci
| Langkah | Backend | Frontend |
|---|---|---|
| Login | `api/app/controllers/api/v1/authentication_controller.rb` | `web/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`, token di localStorage `auth_token` |
| Assessment & skill | `assessments_controller.rb`, `Assessments::SystemPromptCompiler` | `pages/assessments/*`, `components/assessment/SkillPicker.tsx` |
| Undangan | `sessions_controller.rb#create` (`invite_url` = `APP_BASE_URL/interview/<token>`) | `AssessmentInvitePage.tsx` |
| Interview | `api/app/channels/audio_websocket_middleware.rb` (~800 baris), `api/app/clients/gemini/live_client.rb`, `Sessions::StartHandler/EndHandler` | `pages/interview/InterviewPage.tsx`, `hooks/useAudio*.ts`, `public/audio-worklet-processor.js` (PCM16 16 kHz naik, 24 kHz turun) |
| Coverage | `CoverageAnalyzerWorker` → `Coverage::Analyzer` + `StateEngine`, `Coverage::MapInjector` | `pages/monitor/LiveMonitorPage.tsx`, `hooks/useCoverageWebSocket.ts` |
| Portfolio | `PortfolioGeneratorWorker` → `Portfolios::Generator` | `pages/portfolio/PortfolioPage.tsx`, `components/portfolio/*` |
| Fit/gap & export | `FitGap::Engine`, `Exports::PdfGenerator`, `portfolios_controller.rb` | `pages/fitgap/FitGapReportPage.tsx`, `components/fitgap/ComparisonTable.tsx` |

### Config (nama saja)
- API: `api/config/application.yml` (Figaro, gitignored; template `application.yml.sample`): `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `DB_HOST/PORT/USERNAME/PASSWORD`, `REDIS_URL`, `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (wajib), `APP_BASE_URL` (= origin **web**), `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_LIVE/FLASH/PRO_MODEL`. Nama DB dev di-hardcode `rakamin_development`.
- Web: `web/.env` dari `.env.example` (`VITE_API_BASE_URL`, `VITE_WS_BASE_URL`, opsional `VITE_SPEED_TEST_*`, `VITE_REQUIRE_CAMERA`).
